title: Dynamite Stick x19
body:
"Can be used to output a huge explosion, with a large range. Any dynamite sticks which blow up other explosives will have a chain reaction, and explosives can be used to chop trees or break ores."

Description

The Dynamite Stick x19 has a powerful explosion, and a large radius. Like any other explosive, it damages trees and ores.

Unlike bombs, dynamite blows up almost instantly in a chain reaction.

The Dynamite Stick x19 can be bought from the Dugg's Digging
